other_conditions: Applicant must be a native of Chhattisgarh
Applicant must be a person with a disability or a dwarf
Applicant must be listed in the Below Poverty Line (BPL) families
Children with disabilities aged 6-17 are eligible; those aged 6-14 must be attending school
Persons with disabilities aged 18 or above must have a disability of 40% or more
Applicant must not be receiving pension benefits from any other central or state government pension scheme
benefits_summary: Eligible beneficiaries receive a pension of ₹500 per month, directly transferred to their bank account.
